title: van der Lans v KLM (Case C-257/14), 17 September 2015
source: van der Lans v KLM (Case C-257/14), 17 September 2015
excerpt: a technical problem, such as that at issue in the main proceedings, which occurred unexpectedly, which is not attributable to poor maintenance and which was also not detected during routine maintenance checks, does not fall within the definition of ‘extraordinary circumstances’ within the meaning of that provision.
summary: An unexpected technical failure not caused by poor maintenance and not found in routine checks is not an extraordinary circumstance.
